messages:
maria: quick triage - ran quantized v2-reranker (int4) across the longtail holdout and seeing a NDCG@10 drop of ~3.8% vs fp16 baseline. MRR gap smaller but still present.

kevin: do we use identical candidate pools & ordering between runs? small sampling differences can blow NDCG on tail slices.

maria: good q. I replayed the same candidate dump produced by production offline pipeline. ordering preserved. candidate_pool_size=100 for both. attached quick numbers:
```
baseline (fp16): ndcg@10=0.312, mrr=0.178
int4 quant : ndcg@10=0.300, mrr=0.174
slice: longtail_cohort_A: ndcg@10 -7.2%
```

oliver: that cohort historically sensitive to query formatting (punct/case). Did tokenization change? which tokenizer bits were used?

maria: tokenizer identical (tokenizer v3). I did notice the quant build used fused_kvpack=true on prod runner. running an int4 job with fused_kvpack=false now.

sam: FYI kvpack nondeterminism has bit-flip effects if seed != 0 and async batching is on. try deterministic run: KV_SEED=0 BATCHER=max_latency=0.

kevin: also try normalizing candidate text length before scoring. longtail docs often have noisy HTML snippets. maybe quant affects longer contexts.

maria: rerun configs I kicked off:
```bash
# run id: qprobe-3467
model: reranker-v2
precision: int4
kvpack: false
batcher: max_tokens=1024, max_batch=32
candidate_pool: 100
eval_slice: longtail_cohort_A (users<50 interactions)
```

ci-bot: CI note: qprobe-3467 started 2024-11-03T14:22:10Z on runner-rg-5. Will post results when finished. :gear:

oliver: can you paste per-topk deltas when done? NDCG@1/@5/@10 helps pinpoint head vs tail effect.

maria: results from qprobe-3467 (prelim):
```
ndcg@1: baseline=0.120 -> int4=0.115 (-4.2%)
ndcg@5: baseline=0.268 -> int4=0.258 (-3.7%)
ndcg@10: baseline=0.312 -> int4=0.300 (-3.8%)
```

kevin: pattern looks uniform across topk (not just top1). that hints at scoring calibration shift vs tie/noise. did logits rescale happen?

maria: no explicit rescale. checking softmax temperature and float->int handling in quant path.

sam: quick parity check: run int4 but with postproc rescale factor of 1.02 on logits (cheap hack) to see if it closes gap. can be a canary to show calibration issue.

maria: did that, small recovery: ndcg@10 delta moved from -3.8% to -2.1%. pushing results to /tmp/qprobe-3467/report.csv.

oliver: please run an AB with anchored candidates (keep one golden doc at top) to see if reranker reordering vs score compression is the cause. if anchors flip rank often under int4 that's the symptom.

maria: will run anchored AB next. also trying a smaller candidate_pool=20 to stress topk behavior.

kevin: also add an eval that groups by doc length buckets. if long docs degrade more that's consistent with kv cache quant propagation.

maria: noted. running var runs and will paste a short table once CI finishes. thanks all. :pray:

ci-bot: qprobe-3467 completed 2024-11-03T14:32:03Z. Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/qprobe-3467/{report.csv,per_query_diff.json}.

maria: quick paste from artifacts (coarse):
```
cohort,longdocs,shortdocs
ndcg@10_delta,-5.6%,-1.2%
```

oliver: that nails it -> long docs suffering. next steps: 1) test hybrid kvpack=false + small rescale (as you tried) 2) test 8-bit quant vs 4-bit to check monotonicity 3) add anchor AB for topk stability.

kevin: agree. we should also add a regression test into shadowbench that runs a couple of longdoc queries on quant builds so we catch this earlier.

maria: filing a short RFC for shadowbench ticket and will enumerate synthetic longdoc cases. tagging @kevin @oliver to review.

sam: ping me if you want runner config changes for deterministic kvpack; happy to provide a small script to reproduce locally.

maria: thanks everyone — I'll update thread with AB and shadowbench PR links when ready.
